newsitem.title: GERMANY: Germany weighing petrol tax hike - sources.
newsitem.headline: Germany weighing petrol tax hike - sources.

text.p: Germany's centre-right coalition government is considering increasing petrol taxes, coalition sources said on Wednesday.

Finance Minister Theo Waigel is looking for ways to fill a multibillion mark gap in 1997 government spending stemming from a rise in child allowance and the elimination of a wealth tax agreed this week.

Parliamentary and party leaders from Chancellor Helmut Kohl's Christian Democrat coalition discussed the possibility of a petrol tax rise at the chancellor's office on Wednesday, but reached no decision, the sources said.

For now, they will wait and see what savings measures are proposed by the opposition Social Democrats, who hold a majority of the upper house of parliament, before deciding what further steps are neede, they said.
"We are furiously calculating and discussing (the possibilities)," one source said.
